messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — metering-consumer-group lag > 1,200,000 msgs (eu-kafka-01). Alerts: high lag, delayed usage emits, potential customer overage flags. Link: https://internal.ops/alerts/1717771999
liam: oncall here, looking
raj: seeing the same in consumer metrics dashboard, lag started ~15m ago
liam: any deploys in the last hour?
deploy-bot: deploys: none in last 60m for service=meterring-consumer (tag: stable)
emma: support already seeing a spike in overage flags — a few customers pinged via email
liam: ok prioritizing mitigation. raj, can you attach logs for the consumer pod?
raj: grabbing logs — one sec
raj: logs show repeated GC stalls on metering-consumer-3 -> long STW pauses (~6s) and reconnects to kafka
raj: snippet: ```
2026-03-18T12:03:21Z WARN GC pause 6123ms
2026-03-18T12:03:27Z ERROR consumer: heartbeat timeout -> rejoin
```
liam: that would explain the consumer not committing offsets -> backlog piling up -> delayed emits -> overage flags
liam: immediate plan: 1) rotate consumer pod, 2) temporarily increase consumer parallelism, 3) suppress overage alerts for affected window, 4) run targeted backfill if needed
emma: support wants ETA before contacting customers. Can we estimate impact window?
raj: backlog ~1.2M msgs, avg processing ~850 msgs/s on healthy pod -> ~1400s (~23m) if we get full capacity back
liam: doing step 1 now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer -n prod`
deploy-bot: rollout triggered by liam — deployment/metring-consumer restarting (3 pods)
liam: restarting didn't fully fix — pod 2 still shows GC spikes, memory graph looks elevated on that host (node eu-prod-12)
raj: suspect node-level memory pressure -> moving pod to a different node
liam: cordon/evict performed on eu-prod-12, new pod scheduled on eu-prod-07
raj: new pod has steady processing, avg 900 msgs/s, lag dropping -> good sign :thumbsup:
liam: stepping to step 2: temporarily scale replicas from 3 -> 6 to shred backlog faster
liam: `kubectl scale deploy metering-consumer --replicas=6 -n prod`
deploy-bot: scale request accepted — replicas: 3 -> 6
raj: with 6 replicas processing ~5k msgs/s, backlog should clear in ~240s (~4m)
emma: I recommend we suppress automated overage notifications for the affected emit window (start=1717771700). I can open a ticket to reconcile once counts catch up
liam: agreed. @emma please create the suppression and notify billing team. Keep a list of affected customers for manual note.
emma: opening suppression now — ticket ID SUP-2026-128. Notifying billing and CS. Message to customers deferred until counts reconcile
sre: quick ask — do we need a backfill job or will the normal pipeline catch up without duplicates?
raj: normal pipeline will process queued messages; we won't re-ingest. No duplicate risk if offsets commit properly. If offsets lost, we'll backfill from kafka offsets manually.
liam: monitoring: lag -> 300k -> 50k -> 0 in ~6m. Emitting pipeline resumed.
liam: last step: scale back to 3 replicas and uncordon eu-prod-12 after we confirm node health
liam: `kubectl scale deploy metering-consumer --replicas=3 -n prod` and `kubectl uncordon eu-prod-12`
deploy-bot: scale and uncordon executed
emma: support: holding customer notifications. If any customer reaches billing threshold while suppression is active, we'll notify them manually with context.
emma: creating follow-up doc in runbook: https://internal.docs/runbooks/metering-consumer-incident-1717771999
liam: root cause (provisional): node memory pressure causing GC stalls -> consumer pod pauses -> offsets not committed -> backlog -> delayed emits -> automated overage flags triggered for a window
liam: postmortem items: - investigate eu-prod-12 memory leak / noisy tenant, - add GC metrics alert earlier, - add consumer autoscale knob for burst drain, - tighten runbook steps for suppression and support comms
raj: tagging owners and follow-ups: @sre for node investigation, @eng-runtime for consumer memory regression, @billing for reconciliation plan
emma: thanks team. I'll draft the customer-facing note if we need it later. Closing pager and monitoring for 30m to ensure stability. :white_check_mark:
